shots.shows: The pub hub on a Tuesday evening: Tonight's patrons (Sir Charles, four Regulars, four Seasoned), 87 Checks, the selected deck and the hub's buttons.
Round 2 of a match against Old Nell Ashby, the player ahead one round to none, cards on both boards (Sergeant Pike and Steam Hammer on the player's side) and a hand of four to play.
The full-card zoom for a card on the player's board mid-match (Sergeant Pike when he is out): art, points, family, rarity, keyword, flavour text.
The deck builder open on "Heavy Industry" (20/20 cards, 45/60 points, legal), filtered to the Foundry and the cards the player owns.
The chalkboard: the Tuesday Knockout and the Peelers' Cup open to enter, the Reichenbach Open locked, each with its entry rule, cost and prize. No Birthday Invitational.
The Tuesday Knockout bracket: the quarterfinal won against Dodgy Reg Farrow, the semifinal against Ada Lovelace next, the final against Charles Dickens.
